crew.overview: On the rugged isle of Berk, where Vikings and dragons have been bitter enemies for generations, Hiccup stands apart, defying centuries of tradition when he befriends Toothless, a feared Night Fury dragon. Their unlikely bond reveals the true nature of dragons, challenging the very foundations of Viking society.
crew.title: How to Train Your Dragon

details.biography:
Christopher Raimo is a visual effects producer at Framestore. He was the production visual effects producer for Jurassic World (2015), and he also served as visual effects producer on Pacific Rim (2013). In 2017, he was a visual effects producer on Star Wars: Episode VIII – The Last Jedi (2017).

His contributions have been recognised in award nominations. Pacific Rim (2013) was nominated for the Visual Effects Society Award for Outstanding Visual Effects in a Visual Effects-Driven Feature Motion Picture; he shared that nomination.

Raimo’s role bridges creative, technical, and managerial aspects of visual effects production. He has worked for studios such as Industrial Light & Magic and through Image Engine.
details.name: Christopher Raimo
